sources.duplicate_source_policy: all candidate meta and data hashes must agree; retain every candidate and canonical-choice reason

regions.WBC: first four wet tracer cells east of western wall in each wet row
regions.eastern: last four wet tracer cells west of eastern wall excluding WBC
regions.southern: ten southernmost wet tracer rows excluding WBC and eastern
regions.northern: ten northernmost wet tracer rows excluding WBC and eastern

face_carrier.U: tracer cell immediately east at same (j,i)
face_carrier.V: tracer cell immediately north at same (j,i)

canonical_serialization.level_support_token: compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON object with keys levels and weights_hex; weights_hex are lowercase Python/C99 binary64 float.hex strings

anchor_indices.0: first declared anchor for the role
anchor_indices.1: second declared anchor for the role
anchor_indices.2: third declared anchor for the role

long_membership.train_region_constraints: two WBC and at least one each interior/eastern/northern/southern
long_membership.train_depth_constraints_U_V_Theta: at least two each in levels 1-5, 6-10, 11-15
long_membership.validation_and_blind_U_V_Theta_compositi: exactly two single-level directions and one multi-level direction, collectively upper/middle/deep and three distinct regions
assignment_objective: maximize minimum physical centre separation among selected directions
break exact objective ties by response-v1 SHA order

candidate_subregions.WBC: four equal-rank latitude quartiles after sorting eligible candidates south-to-north, with candidate SHA order breaking equal-coordinate ties
candidate_subregions.eastern: four equal-rank latitude quartiles after sorting eligible candidates south-to-north, with candidate SHA order breaking equal-coordinate ties
candidate_subregions.northern: four equal-rank longitude quartiles after sorting eligible candidates west-to-east, with candidate SHA order breaking equal-coordinate ties
candidate_subregions.southern: four equal-rank longitude quartiles after sorting eligible candidates west-to-east, with candidate SHA order breaking equal-coordinate ties
candidate_subregions.interior: four geographic quadrants split at the midpoint of the minimum and maximum eligible-candidate longitude and latitude; midpoint coordinates belong to the western/southern half

joint_spatial_allocator.subregion_centroid: normalized Cartesian mean of unit-sphere lon/lat vectors for eligible candidates in the subregion, converted back to lon/lat; an empty subregion fails
lexicographic_objectives: DEPRECATED 2026-08-26 -- replaced by joint_objective_scope.objective_method's deterministic greedy farthest-point placement; kept only as the historical record of the exact-MIP objective v1/v2 attempted to prove optimal: maximize lexicographically the ascending-sorted five-region vector of within-region minimum cross-role great-circle separations; then the ascending-sorted five-region vector of within-region minimum within-role great-circle separations; then the tertiary tuple of summed WBC mean surface speed and per-region proximity to subregion centroids.

joint_objective_scope.solve_unit: one (regime,family,region) stratum across all four roles, matching section 9.3 step 3's own text; SSH point and smooth slots participate in the same SSH solve within that stratum. The one deliberate exception is the non-WBC cross-role Chebyshev-3 hard constraint (section 9.3 step 4), which section 9.3 states without a same-region qualifier and which therefore is verified and, if necessary, repaired across region boundaries after every stratum solves independently -- see cross_region_repair below.
joint_objective_scope.cross_region_coupling: apply the non-WBC later-role Chebyshev-distance-three constraint against every earlier-role centre even when its region label differs
joint_objective_scope.undefined_pairwise_minimum: omit a region component only when fewer than two eligible selected centres exist for that pair class; every remaining component must be finite
joint_objective_scope.objective_vector_comparison: DEPRECATED 2026-08-26 -- greedy placement has no MIP objective vector to compare exactly; achieved separations are computed by direct brute-force distance recomputation on the small final selection (_brute_force_region_minima) and reported, not compared against a claimed optimum. Candidate SHA order remains the sole tie-break, applied at each individual placement rather than after a complete frozen vector.
joint_objective_scope.ssh_cross_kernel_ownership_tie_break: after the complete physical objective vector ties, order SSH (slot,candidate) ownership variables by the ascending tuple (candidate tie SHA-256, region-slot SHA-256) and lexicographically maximize their binary selection vector (1 before 0); this assigns point-versus-gaussian ownership without changing the candidate grammar or selected global centre set

cross_region_repair.mechanism: allocate_centres_lexicographically_by_region solves every (regime,family,region) stratum independently via the unchanged allocate_centres_lexicographically, then checks the assembled selection for non-WBC cross-role Chebyshev-3 violations that cross a region boundary; any violation excludes the offending later-role (validation/blind_test) centre from its own region's candidate pool and re-solves only that region.
cross_region_repair.measured_boundary_adjacency: 2406 non-WBC cell pairs within Chebyshev distance 2 cross a region boundary, against 36192 that do not (6.2%), on the real production grid

joint_objective_scope.objective_method: deterministic_farthest_point_greedy_v3: process every row in one fixed order (role order, then region-slot SHA); for each row pick the eligible candidate maximizing, in order, (i) minimum distance to already-placed cells of a different role, (ii) minimum distance to already-placed cells of the same role, (iii) the physical/geographic tertiary preference, (iv) ascending candidate SHA-256. Achieved separation is reported, not proven optimal.

wbc_speed_source.store: trajectories_v3.zarr state channels U_01 and V_01

region_slot_assignment.pilot: use the exact six-case region sequence in the amplitude-pilot contract
region_slot_assignment.production_strata: (role,regime,family,kernel-quota-family), where U/V/Theta each use one gaussian stratum and SSH point/smooth use separate quota strata
region_slot_assignment.region_label_stream: repeatedly traverse [WBC,interior,eastern,northern,southern], emitting one label whose declared quota remains, until every quota is exhausted
region_slot_assignment.base_assignment: zip the SHA-ordered slots to the quota-exact region-label stream
region_slot_assignment.assignment: use the quota-exact SHA-zip base assignment unless it makes the complete frozen long-membership constraints infeasible; only then apply the minimum-Hamming constrained repair before centre optimization

repair_if_long_membership_infeasible.activation: only when no assignment of long-membership indicators satisfies every frozen long constraint under the base region labels
repair_if_long_membership_infeasible.feasibility_scope: jointly across the three regimes for one role and input family, including SSH point/smooth kernel constraints where applicable
immutable_constraints: all declared per-role per-regime per-family per-kernel regional quotas
all exact long counts anchor counts kernel counts and kernel sequences
all single-level multi-level upper-middle-deep and designated-combination formulas
all within-regime distinct-region and across-regime all-five-region requirements
repair_if_long_membership_infeasible.primary_objective: minimize the number of direction-slot region labels changed from the base assignment
repair_if_long_membership_infeasible.tie_break: order slots by the frozen region-slot SHA; within each slot order permissible region labels by ascending repair-hash SHA; among globally feasible minimum-Hamming assignments lexicographically minimize the resulting per-slot region-rank vector

post_selection_row_mapping.slot_order: ascending region-slot SHA-256 already used for region assignment
post_selection_row_mapping.centre_order: ascending candidate tie SHA-256 using the frozen response-v1 centre grammar
post_selection_row_mapping.assignment: after any SSH cross-kernel ownership tie is resolved, within each stratum zip the ordered direction slots to the ordered selected centres

restart_edit.U: selected Uvel native W-face cells only
restart_edit.V: selected Vvel native S-face cells only

curated_storage.response_chunk: one direction, one sign, one lead, all 46x62x62 values
curated_storage.input_chunk: one direction, one sign, all 46x62x62 values
curated_storage.canonical_json_lines: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, frozen line order

stored_response_semantics.response_p64: raw P64(perturbed_endpoint)-P64(paired_nominal_endpoint) in float64 physical state units

supersedes.reason: v2's region-decomposed exact MIP leximax solver was mathematically correct but still impractically slow at production scale: after fixing a 90+ minute parallel-worker BLAS thread-oversubscription stall, a sequential re-run found S0/U/WBC (1,505 candidates, smaller than S0/Theta/WBC's 3,297, which had already solved completely in 503s) ran over 45 minutes without finishing its first sub-stage -- candidate-pool size does not predict leximax cost, conflict-graph density does, and that cost cannot be bounded in advance short of solving it. Replaced with a deterministic greedy farthest-point placement (section 9.3 step 3, amended 2026-08-26) that achieves and reports separation rather than proving it globally optimal -- nothing about the study's scientific validity depends on that proof, only on the hard constraints (distinct IDs, the non-WBC distance-three rule, regional quotas, the Phase-A exclusion) actually holding, which are unchanged. Verified speedup: S0/U 0.5s, S0/Theta 1.0s (previously 45+ minutes unfinished and 503s respectively for a single region alone). v2 never materialized any output.
